name: play_meters_vu
title: load t-v16, play: 12-track metering, the VU pads, the Pattern screen against the simulator's chrome, stop

steps.note: let the pattern run so that every track that has a note has sounded
the maintainer's expectation: all 12 tracks meter (not every instrument of t-v16 may sound yet: a soft check)
Shift + F7 picks the VU pads; the 12 columns are the 12 tracks' meters

the key-cap row is the part of the Pattern screen that does not depend on the project (compared with the simulator's golden, AA tolerance); soft: the unit's key-cap bar is 0.56x the simulator's brightness (OS-SIMKEY)
stopped: the VU pads fall back to dark

finally.note: Shift + F1 puts the pads back to NOTES
